content.text: SND w Sx or hemodynamic compromise and ↓likelihood of coronary ischemia: isoproterenol, DA, dobutamine or Epi may be considered to ↑HR and improve Sx.
Emergency tx of brady: transcutaneous pacing, atropine and/or isoproterenol.
